sources.entry: Menubar Brightness - macOS app to change the screen brightness on the menubar.

summary.one_liner: Menubar Brightness is a macOS menu bar app for adjusting the screen brightness.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a macOS app that changes screen brightness from the menu bar. Installation is by downloading the latest release, which the README says is macOS only. Usage is limited to a preferences window, opened with ⌘ + ,, where you can choose whether the app opens on login and quit the app. The README credits the wulkano Kap project as a source of code. It does not describe brightness control details, supported displays, or a build process.
use_cases: adjust screen brightness from the menu bar
dim or brighten a Mac display quickly
launch a brightness control at login on macOS
change external monitor brightness from the menu bar
how_to_run: Download the latest release from the repository's releases page (macOS only)
Open the app and press ⌘ + , to open the preferences window
In preferences, choose whether Menubar Brightness opens on login
stack: Kap (source code reused, per README credit)
notable: Lives in the macOS menu bar as a brightness control
Preferences window with a launch-on-login option
Installed from prebuilt release downloads rather than a build step
Source code adapted from the wulkano Kap project, per README
caveats: README is brief and does not document brightness control details or supported displays
